name: Berislava Vila
source:
She is a singer who suddenly appeared in Doush and is gaining popularity all over the world. Berislava uses the nickname “Mava” and an image that hides her identity during performances, interviews and publications. Her producer says: “She would have gained popularity all over the world long ago, overtaking other idols, if she really wanted to”.

Beri refuses glory and rents a room in a simple home from an ordinary human, giving most of her money to an orphanage. Sometimes she sings in Cassandra’s bar as a friend. Perhaps an unknown past and sometimes a dual character do not allow the girl to adapt to the world of people and open up in the world of song.
